changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType]( ExecutionID uniqueidentifier not null, ExecutionItemUid uniqueidentifier null, ItemNumber int not null, SubjectUid uniqueidentifier null, SubjectClass int null, SubjectAssetTypeID int null, SubjectCardinality int not null, ObjectUid uniqueidentifier null, ObjectClass int null, ObjectAssetTypeID int null, ObjectCardinality int not null, PredicateUid uniqueidentifier not null, PredicateID int null, [Message] nvarchar(2500) null, [Success] bit null, [IsNew] bit null, [uid] uniqueidentifier null, CONSTRAINT PK_ApiExecutionRelationshipType PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SubjectClass') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType] add SubjectClass int null end
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SubjectAssetTypeID') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType] add SubjectAssetTypeID int null end
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectClass') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType] add ObjectClass int null end
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectAssetTypeID') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType] add ObjectAssetTypeID int null end
if exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Subject') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType] drop column [Subject] end
if exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Subject') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType] drop column [SubjectID] end
if exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Subject') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType] drop column [Object] end
if exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Subject') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType] drop column [ObjectID] end
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionRelationshipType' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SourceID') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionRelationshipType] add SourceID nvarchar(500) null end
